slideshow.notPaired: Not yet paired. Use Menu or Escape key to open Settings.

srtSink.serverDisabled: Turned on here, but disabled fleet-wide from the admin dashboard — contact your church's AnnouncementSlides admin.
srtSink.latencyHint: Lower for less delay on a clean wired network; raise it if the picture stutters.
srtSink.debugOverlayHint: Shows playback stats on top of the video.
srtSink.intro: Receives a live video feed (OBS, vMix, etc.) from your local network over SRT or RIST and plays it full screen.

modeHint.srt: This device waits for a sender (OBS, vMix, an encoder) to connect to it over SRT. Paste the connect URL below into the sender.
modeHint.rist_unicast: This device waits for a sender to connect to it over RIST. Best when one sender feeds this one device.
modeHint.rist_caller: This device connects out to a sender that is waiting for receivers (in OBS, a RIST output set to listen, e.g. rist://@0.0.0.0:5000). Lets one sender feed many devices. Playback starts by itself when the sender starts, and ends when it stops.
modeHint.rist_multicast: This device joins a multicast group the sender transmits to. Lets one sender feed many devices on a wired network; the group, port and passphrase must match the sender's.

srtSink.multicastWifiWarning: ⚠ This device is on WiFi. Multicast video over WiFi is not recommended — expect dropouts and stutter. Use a wired Ethernet connection.

revelation.noPeers: Not paired with any Revelation instance yet.
revelation.needsRepair: Needs re-pairing — unpair, then pair again
revelation.noneFound: No Revelation instances found on this network.
revelation.intro: Connects as a peer to Revelation Snapshot Presenter software (snapshots.vrbm.org).

advanced.featureOffHint: This feature is turned off — switch it on in Settings > Advanced.
advanced.revelationHint: Let a Revelation presenter on your network take over this display for a live presentation.
advanced.srtSinkHint: Receive a live video feed (OBS, vMix, etc.) from your church network over SRT.
